title: Swap Two Values
statement:
You have two labeled tiffin boxes: a and b.
Write a function that takes two values and returns them swapped as a pair (or list of length 2).
Example: swap(3, 7) → [7, 3].
hints: You need a third helper place — a temp box.
Save a, copy b into a, then put the saved value into b.
Return both values after the swap.

solution.approach: Use a temporary variable: temp = a; a = b; b = temp; then return [a, b].
solution.complexity: Fixed tiny work — always the same few assignments.

code.python:
def swap(a, b):
    temp = a
    a = b
    b = temp
    return [a, b]
